stories.title: The Story of Numbers

stories.title: Sharing the Cupcakes
stories.teaser: Three friends bake six delicious cupcakes together, and now it’s time to share. Everyone wants the same amount, of course! How can they make it perfectly fair?
learning_objectives: Sharing equally means everyone gets the same amount
